Consider that an organization has developed an e-commerce system. After a release that refactored the checkout flow and updated the payment gateway integration, which type of testing should be performed to ensure these existing features still function correctly and no previously working behavior was broken?
Which of the following options best describes the main objective of usability testing?
options: To ensure that the software code is free of syntax errors and logical bugs.
To verify that the software installs correctly across different operating systems and hardware configurations.
To evaluate how easily and intuitively a representative user can interact with the product to achieve their goals.
To confirm that the application’s database can handle a high volume of concurrent transactions.
questions.correct_answer: To evaluate how easily and intuitively a representative user can interact with the product to achieve their goals.
